cards.example_en: The tired horse ate dry straw from a corner of the barn.
cards.example_zh: 那匹疲惫的马吃着谷仓角落里的干稻草。

cards.example_en: The stubborn donkey refused to move until someone offered an apple.
cards.example_zh: 这头倔驴直到有人给它一只苹果才肯动。

cards.example_en: You can substitute honey for sugar in this simple cake recipe.
cards.example_zh: 在这个简单的蛋糕做法里，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

cards.example_en: Babies often suck their thumbs when they begin to feel sleepy.
cards.example_zh: 婴儿开始犯困时，常常会吮吸拇指。

cards.example_en: His suitcase was so heavy that he needed help on the stairs.
cards.example_zh: 他的手提箱太重了，上下楼梯都需要人帮忙。

cards.example_en: The hotel suite had a sofa and two single beds.
cards.example_zh: 这家旅馆的套间里有一张沙发和两张单人床。

cards.example_en: After a whole day at the beach, her shoulders were badly sunburnt.
cards.example_zh: 在海滩待了整整一天后，她的肩膀严重晒伤。

cards.example_en: The supreme court agreed to hear the difficult case next month.
cards.example_zh: 最高法院同意下个月审理这起棘手的案件。

cards.example_en: The shop sold its surplus at half price on the final day.
cards.example_zh: 商店在最后一天以半价出售剩余货物。

cards.example_en: The suspension of local bus service lasted for three whole days.
cards.example_zh: 当地公共汽车停运持续了整整三天。

cards.example_en: Let's swap seats so you can see the stage more clearly.
cards.example_zh: 我们换个座位吧，这样你能把舞台看得更清楚。

cards.example_en: I swear I locked the front door before we left the house.
cards.example_zh: 我发誓，我们离开房子之前我锁上了前门。

cards.example_en: My ankle began to swell soon after I twisted it on the stairs.
cards.example_zh: 我在楼梯上扭了脚踝，不久它就开始肿了。

cards.example_en: A swift reply from the company saved us a great deal of trouble.
cards.example_zh: 公司的迅速回复为我们省去了不少麻烦。

cards.example_en: The city museum displays a sword that once belonged to a general.
cards.example_zh: 市博物馆展出一把曾经属于一位将军的剑。

cards.example_en: A high temperature was the first symptom of his cold.
cards.example_zh: 高烧是他感冒后出现的第一个症状。

cards.example_en: A systematic review of the data revealed several serious errors.
cards.example_zh: 对数据进行系统复查后，发现了几处严重错误。

cards.example_en: Every taxpayer expects public money to be spent with great care.
cards.example_zh: 每位纳税人都希望公共资金得到十分谨慎的使用。

cards.example_en: The technical problem stopped the online class for ten minutes.
cards.example_zh: 技术故障让网课停了十分钟。

cards.example_en: They agreed on a tentative plan to meet again in early March.
cards.example_zh: 他们商定了一个暂定计划，准备在三月初再次见面。

cards.example_en: Passengers should reach the terminal at least two hours before departure.
cards.example_zh: 乘客应至少在出发前两小时到达航站楼。

cards.example_en: The sudden loud explosion filled the narrow street with terror.
cards.example_zh: 突然的巨大爆炸使这条狭窄的街道充满了恐惧。

cards.example_en: His theoretical model still needs support from real experiments.
cards.example_zh: 他的理论模型仍需要真实实验的支持。

cards.example_en: She poured hot tea from a thermos during the long mountain hike.
cards.example_zh: 在漫长的山间徒步中，她从保温瓶里倒出热茶。

cards.example_en: Winning the final gave every player on the team a huge thrill.
cards.example_zh: 赢得决赛让队里的每一名队员都兴奋不已。

cards.example_en: This thriller keeps readers guessing until the very last page.
cards.example_zh: 这部惊悚小说让读者一直猜到最后一页。

cards.example_en: A heavy thunderstorm broke over the lake just after midnight.
cards.example_zh: 午夜刚过，一场大雷暴在湖面上爆发。

cards.example_en: He opened a tin of sweet peaches and shared them for dessert.
cards.example_zh: 他打开一罐甜桃，分给大家当甜点。

cards.example_en: Repeating the same safety drill every afternoon soon became tiresome.
cards.example_zh: 每天下午重复同样的安全演练，很快就令人厌烦。

cards.example_en: Her translation of the short poem keeps both its meaning and its rhythm.
cards.example_zh: 她翻译的这首短诗既保留了原意，也保留了节奏。

cards.example_en: The plastic box is transparent, so you can see the gift inside.
cards.example_zh: 这个塑料盒是透明的，所以你能看见里面的礼物。

cards.example_en: His hands tremble whenever he has to speak before a large crowd.
cards.example_zh: 每当必须在一大群人面前讲话时，他的双手就会发抖。

cards.example_en: An old trolleybus glided quietly along the wide main street.
cards.example_zh: 一辆旧式无轨电车沿着宽阔的主干道悄悄驶过。

cards.example_en: A rescue troop reached the village before the storm.
cards.example_zh: 一支救援军队在暴风雨来临前赶到了村子。

cards.example_en: A troublesome cough kept her awake for most of the night.
cards.example_zh: 一阵烦人的咳嗽让她夜里大部分时间都无法入睡。

cards.example_en: A math tutor comes to our home on Wednesday evenings.
cards.example_zh: 一位数学导师每周三晚上来我们家。

cards.example_en: Grandfather still prefers to write personal letters on an old typewriter.
cards.example_zh: 祖父仍然喜欢用一台旧打字机写私人信件。

cards.example_en: The heat inside the crowded bus became unbearable by early afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 到了午后不久，拥挤的公共汽车里热得让人受不了。

cards.example_en: It seemed unbelievable that such a small team could win the cup.
cards.example_zh: 这样一支小球队竟能赢得奖杯，似乎令人难以置信。

cards.example_en: Their support for the child remained unconditional through every setback.
cards.example_zh: 无论遇到什么挫折，他们对孩子的支持始终是无条件的。

cards.example_en: He lay unconscious for several minutes after falling from the wall.
cards.example_zh: 他从墙上摔下来后，昏迷了好几分钟。

cards.example_en: The factory will undertake the repair of the school roof.
cards.example_zh: 这家工厂将承担学校屋顶的修理工作。

cards.example_en: Pack enough clean underwear in case the trip lasts longer than planned.
cards.example_zh: 带上足够的干净内衣，以防行程比计划的更长。

cards.example_en: Local unemployment rose sharply after the main factory closed last winter.
cards.example_zh: 去年冬天主要工厂关闭后，当地失业率急剧上升。

cards.example_en: It was unfortunate that the train left before they reached the platform.
cards.example_zh: 不幸的是，他们赶到站台时火车已经开走了。

cards.example_en: The workers' union asked the factory for safer stairs.
cards.example_zh: 工人工会要求工厂把楼梯修得更安全。

cards.example_en: Neighbors unite every spring to clean rubbish from the riverbank.
cards.example_zh: 邻居们每年春天都会联合起来，清理河岸上的垃圾。

cards.example_en: He seemed unwilling to lend his new bicycle to anyone at school.
cards.example_zh: 他似乎不愿意把新自行车借给学校里的任何人。

cards.example_en: An upward path led from the quiet village straight to the temple.
cards.example_zh: 一条向上的小路从安静的村庄直通寺庙。

cards.example_en: Grey smoke drifted upwards from the chimney into the cold sky.
cards.example_zh: 灰色的烟从烟囱向上飘进寒冷的天空。
